notes.title: 2025/6/13 Update Patch
notes.content: [p]2025/6/13 Update Patch[/p][list][*][p]Fixed lag issues on certain device models[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where after a room disbanded during combat, players would attempt to re-enter the room when exiting matchmade battles[/p][/*][*][p]New users will now have their language automatically selected based on region during first login[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where random terrain generation on the Rooftop map could occasionally trap players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI freeze when accepting friend invitations while on the main menu or character selection screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some small animals' eyes wouldn't display on medium graphics settings[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized some physics calculations to improve performance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where cookies could sometimes be knocked out of visible bounds on the Cookie map[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Epic Major Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello, fellow Guru Gurus![/p][p]During the ongoing New Product Festival, [i]Guru Guru[/i] has received an [b]epic major update[/b]![/p][p][b]Game Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]All scene assets have been updated—a brand-new Guru Guru world awaits you![/p][/*][*][p]More playable Guru Gurus have been added, and existing ones have received adorable new looks. Try them all![/p][/*][*][p]Refreshed UI assets make the entire game feel brand new.[/p][/*][*][p]A revamped tutorial ensures even first-time players can easily become a proper Guru Guru.[/p][/*][*][p]A dynamic terrain system ensures that the same map offers a fresh experience every time.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced physics for more realism and greater challenges.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved online connectivity—no more worries about finding teammates![/p][/*][*][p]Better controller support for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AI combat behavior in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed texture tearing issues for some characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed bugs from the previous demo.[/p][/*][/list][p]
